author: Ak4shik
quote: The graphics are great, amount and quality of mechanics are great, but GTA is the only game, that LIMITS those mechanics(you know what I'm talking about). The game supposed to be something I can't do in my real life, but GTA6 gives you less options than real life - for example, I can legally get a prostitute at the place where I live, but not in the game. The amount of simping is wild, Jason is ***** **** guy, with no backstory or any reason why he is doing anything in his life(except simping). Most of the dialogs are so much stupid, it's literally like asking a fith grader to do an epic scene(dumbest way possible). I've heard the radio show that just shows the opposite of real life(the republican interviewer shown as leftist irl and drop a dialog midway, just because he didn't like the response). Such a great potential and such a disappointment. I hope user rating of GTA 6 will show everyone that we will not silently take all that trash company's sell us and in the future only the great games will get a higher rating from critics and finances from customers.
